newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican confirms Pope to enter hospital Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Vatican confirms Pope to enter hospital Sunday.

text.p: The Vatican said on Friday Pope John Paul would enter hospital on Sunday evening for his planned operation.

The 76-year-old Polish Pope is due to undergo surgery to have his appendix removed. The Vatican did not say when the operation would take place but sources said it would most likely be Monday or Tuesday.
The operation will take place at Rome's Gemelli hospital, where the Pope has undergone surgery five times since his election in 1978.
On Thursday night, the Vatican denied an Italian news agency report that Pope John Paul may be suffering from a new tumour. The 76-year-old Pope had a colon tumour removed in a 1992 operation.
The Vatican says an inflamed appendix is the cause of the Pope's recent illnesses, fevers and discomfort.

Some doctors in Italy and abroad who are not treating the Pope have expressed scepticism about the Vatican's official version of what is ailing the leader of the world's some 960 million Roman Catholics.
